component.name: GuildSync Companion
component.summary: Uploads GuildSync saved data to twilighttavern.co

description.p: GuildSync Companion runs in your system tray and uploads your World of Warcraft: Forever character data to twilighttavern.co for you. It also keeps the GuildSync addon up to date inside your client.
It never modifies the game client itself: it reads the SavedVariables file the addon writes and POSTs it to the guild site on a schedule.
